info.title: TRON Console HTTP API
info.description: Repository-defined existing API. Unversioned wire protocol; document version only. See console-api.md for state/side-effect and freshness rules. POST JSON object size 1..16384 bytes. Exact same-origin localhost Host required. No automatic retries/idempotency keys.

ConsoleToken.name: X-TRON-Token
ConsoleToken.description: Obtain from GET /api/state; rotated on server restart.

confirmed_physical_relocation.description: Required when supervisor state is STAIR; operator typed confirmation after physically moving to flat ground.

confirmed_run_id.description: Required for a retained stair run; must match fresh operator_phase.run_id.

raw_copies.description: Remote raw LiDAR/IMU transfer continues after local BAG busy becomes false.

raw_capture_unverified.description: A failed remote seal blocks starting another raw recording until the old capture is checked.

return_started.description: Stored flag distinguishing a return attempt from an outbound retry.

retry_available.description: Computed state hint: incomplete outbound session can be retried using existing start endpoint. Readiness is checked again at start.

destination.description: Optional; if present must equal retained stair landing ID
